Z+ Compiler 1.3.5

Z+ 1.3.5 is the final stabilization release of the 1.3.x series. ZPM and ZPBuild remain at 1.0.0.

Included and verified

  • Compiler release metadata and the CLI version identify 1.3.5.
  • The release regression suite covers the existing parser, interpreter, native backend, runtime, standard library, package manager, build system, and installer workflows.
  • Parser recovery now guarantees token progress when synchronization stops on a token that the enclosing parse loop would otherwise retry. Regression cases cover:
    • Malformed switch terminators.
    • Malformed struct and enum members.
    • Legacy switch recovery.
    • An imported class member using the unsupported pub modifier.
    These cases terminate with diagnostics; class visibility modifiers remain outside the 1.3.5 language.
  • The existing imported ZShell project passes zp check, zp dependencies, and zp build. Its interactive zp run displays the greeting and prompt; the application remains in its command loop by design.
  • The input runtime changes present in this worktree support prompted and unprompted line and typed input, with interpreter/native Windows coverage, EOF and conversion error handling, and native string-rooting stress cases.
  • The Windows x64 release was built with Inno Setup 7.1.1. The generated installer, manifest, and SHA-256 sidecar were checked; an isolated install ran the installed project workflow and uninstalled cleanly.
  • The final installer audit verified an upgrade from 1.3.4, same-version repair, default and custom install locations, PATH restoration, and uninstallation.
    • Setup refuses to downgrade a newer registered compiler or relocate an existing installation during repair or upgrade.
    • Build staging verifies the staged compiler hash and includes shipped tools and runtime resources without unit-test binaries, benchmarks, or linker artifacts.
    • New installs refuse nonempty unregistered destination directories to avoid replacing unrelated files.
  • The complete Windows Release CTest run passed 50/50 tests, including package resolution, ZPBuild workflows, runtime/input tests, native execution, and installer workflow tests.

Compatibility

No intentional language or package-format incompatibility is introduced by the version update. ZPM and ZPBuild versions are unchanged. The compiler's native backend continues to have a narrower supported platform and feature set than the interpreter; see NATIVE_BACKEND.md.

Limitations

The architecture work recommended for 1.4.0 is described in docs/1.4.0-ROADMAP.md.
